newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Q1 GDP growth seen up 5 to 6 pct - Ortiz.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Q1 GDP growth seen up 5 to 6 pct - Ortiz.

text.p: Mexico's gross domestic product likely grew between five percent and six percent in the first quarter of 1997, Finance Minister Guillermo Ortiz said on Monday.
Ortiz's comment came during a trip to Merida, capital of Yucatan state, where the minister met with local business leaders.
GDP growth in the first quarter "probably will be between five and six percent," Ortiz said, according to a Finance Ministry news release.
The government statistics institute INEGI is due to announce first-quarter GDP at constant prices on May 19.
That Q1 growth would put Mexico on track for the government goal of 4.5 percent GDP growth for the year, Ortiz said.
